definitions.explanation: A small beetle with a rounded, dome-shaped body, typically red or orange with black spots. Considered beneficial in gardens as they eat aphids.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}にてんとう{虫|むし}がいた。
examples.english: There was a ladybug in the garden.

examples.japanese: てんとう{虫|むし}は{害虫|がいちゅう}を{食|た}べてくれる{益虫|えきちゅう}だ。
examples.english: Ladybugs are beneficial insects that eat pests.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}と{黒|くろ}の{模様|もよう}のてんとう{虫|むし}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a ladybug with a red and black pattern.

examples.japanese: てんとう{虫|むし}は{幸運|こううん}のシンボルとされている。
examples.english: Ladybugs are considered a symbol of good luck.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {天道虫|てんとうむし} or {瓢虫|てんとうむし}. Usually written in hiragana as てんとう{虫|むし}.

NAME ORIGIN: {天道|てんとう} refers to the sun or heavens. The name comes from the ladybug's habit of flying toward the sun when placed on a finger.

SPECIES IN JAPAN:
・ナナホシテントウ - seven-spot ladybird (most common)
・ナミテントウ - Asian ladybeetle
・ニジュウヤホシテントウ - 28-spotted potato ladybird (plant pest)

ECOLOGICAL ROLE:
・{益虫|えきちゅう} - beneficial insect
・アブラムシを{食|た}べる - eats aphids
・{害虫|がいちゅう}{駆除|くじょ} - pest control

CULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS: Like in Western cultures, ladybugs are associated with good luck in Japan. Finding one is considered a good omen.

RELATED INSECTS:
・カブトムシ - rhinoceros beetle
・クワガタムシ - stag beetle
・カマキリ - praying mantis
